column5: Exactly one TiKV table or index scan lowers into the list-based DAGRequest with resolved timezone name/offset, pushdown flags, optional execution summaries and nondefault div precision, and Default/Chunk encoding; TypeChunk always includes the exact host-endian ChunkMemoryLayout. Multi-executor trees, TiFlash root executors, session construction, ranges, readers, regions, and RPC remain external.

The live source-admitted TiKV CopSingleRead path carries one validated index pushdown into PhysicalIndexScanPlan; candidate cost ID, resolved schema ID/UNIQUE/column count, and proposed protobuf values must match before task construction, then lowering preserves IDs, columns, direction, common-handle IDs, and exact checkCoverIndex width/NULL rules. Partition, multi-valued, FTS/vector, live DDL schema-state column selection, and extra-column resolution remain external.
